rca of the issue: USER BUG: XAUUSD SELL opened with TP 450 pips away — 'too far, will never be reached.' RCA: ai_signals.py MTF geometry was `tp_dist_price = ATR_TP_MULTIPLIER (5.0) * atr15`; on gold with atr15 ≈ $9 USD → tp_dist_price = $45 = 450 pips. FIX: added MTF_TP{1,2,3}_MAX_PIPS caps (100/200/200) applied AFTER ratio fanout, and reduced SL_MAX_PIPS 250→120 so the weighted R:R (0.5*100+0.25*200+0.25*200)/120=1.25 stays above the 1.1 MTF_RR_FLOOR. Without the SL reduction the fix would have been self-defeating (every gold trade would fail the R:R floor with a 200-pip weighted TP over a 250-pip SL = 0.6 R:R, forcing HOLD). MITIGATION verified: (1) large-ATR gold now caps tp3 exactly at 200 pips, (2) small-ATR gold and EURUSD are unaffected (caps only shrink, never extend), (3) monotonic ordering preserved, (4) R:R veto does not trigger, (5) full MTF regression stays green (85/85 across 7 files).
